name: MiniMax H3 Image (Official, beta)
description: Official Draw Things preset for MiniMax H3 Image — a 16MP image model (beta)
notes:
BETA / UNVERIFIED: copied verbatim from the official app export (minimax_h3_image_i4x.ckpt): 6 steps, TFG 1, DDIM Trailing, shift 3, 4096x4096 = 16MP without an upscaler. The upstream model card agrees on 6 steps / CFG 1 / ~16MP (working range 4-20MP). Kontext-style reference model - up to 16 reference images, addressed in the prompt as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>; strength must stay 1.0. NOT yet present on the .150 server and gRPC support is unconfirmed.

TILING: this export has tiledDecoding=false, but the H3 VAE reference implementation decodes in 256px tiles and turning tiling OFF changes the output - so tiling is part of the reference config, not just a memory trick. Community VRAM guidance: 8GB -> 512px tiles, 12GB -> 768px tiles, 16GB -> untiled decode. 4096x4096 untiled will not fit 12GB; expect a memory kill. If output looks subtly wrong, compare tiled vs untiled before blaming the sampler. ASSETS PRESENT BUT NOT SERVED: .150 has minimax_h3_image_i4x.ckpt (24.16GB) and minimax_h3_image_vae_f16.ckpt (1.09GB); the qwen3_vl_32b text encoder (~15.3GB) is the same one FastH3 Omni already runs with. The gRPC list_files does not advertise the model, which is a server-support gap, not a memory one: FastH3 Omni is 25.21GB (bigger) and runs on this box by spilling. Expect the same spill behaviour, not impossibility.
